summary.text: Mike Lefor is a Republican member of the North Dakota House of Representatives, representing District 37 (home city listed as Dickinson), serving since 2015 per the legislature's member page; the page lists the role of Majority Leader.

paragraphs.text: The legislature's biography for Lefor lists an occupation of President, Blackridge Enterprises LLC.
It lists education as Dickinson State University Graduate.
It also lists President, Dickinson Park Board (2006-2014), Chairman, CHI St. Joseph Hospital (2008-2014), City Commission (2016) and Chairman, Planning and Zoning Commission (1993-2003).
Family is listed as: Married (Sherryl); 3 children.
